usage: cox chair [-h] {run,service,ask,attach,answer,decisions,watchdog,freeze-lands} ...

The chair loop that runs the landing and launch ticks itself.

positional arguments:
  {run,service,ask,attach,answer,decisions,watchdog,freeze-lands}
    run                 beat, gather, plan, perform and report every tick until interrupted
    service             write or show the systemd user unit that keeps `cox chair run` alive
    ask                 put a question with its options to the operator on the courier bus
    attach              say whether a live chair loop holds the lease; exit 0 if so, 1 if not
    answer              answer an open decision with one of its options
    decisions           list decisions asked of the operator and their answers
    watchdog            one-shot loop check for a five-minute timer; reads only the store
    freeze-lands        hold every land for a release cut, show the freeze, or lift it

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

examples:
  cox chair run --once --dry-run
  cox chair run --interval 30
  cox chair service --install
  cox chair ask "ship it?" --option yes --option no
